metadata.components_note: t2k.3dsx is recorded MISSING on purpose: `make production` builds the cia target, which never produces the .3dsx. A build that also runs `make 3ds` will report it and MISMATCH against this baseline until the baseline is regenerated from a tree that built it.
metadata.elf_note: t2k.elf embeds TWO things that make its hash move: the -ffile-prefix-map=$(REPO_ROOT)=/build flag (t2k_3ds/Makefile), which rewrote the __FILE__ path baked in by nlohmann's JSON_ASSERT and is what makes the .elf path-neutral across clones, and T2K_BUILD_REV / T2K_BUILD_DATE from build/build_rev.h, which stamp the git rev into the binary by design (t2k_3ds/Makefile:313-322). The second means the .elf component of a baseline is only equal for builds made AT THIS COMMIT; every other component (banner.cgfx, banner.bnr, t2k.smdh, the canonical romfs) is commit-independent and must match across commits. Do not 'fix' an .elf mismatch by dropping the prefix-map flag.
metadata.equality: Components are the equality target. The .cia sha256 under informational is NOT one: makerom seeds rand() from time(0) (ticket/content IDs) and walks the romfs with an unsorted readdir(), so correct builds of identical inputs get different .cia bytes by design.
